template.title: Template check
template.description: The check is a Jinja template. It's a problem when the template renders truthy (true / "on" / a non-empty string); OK when it renders false / "" / "off".

aggregator.title: Aggregator
aggregator.description: One problem sensor that turns on whenever a labelled entity is in a problem state.

data_description.labels: Every entity carrying one of these labels is watched.
data_description.match: "any" watches entities in any selected label; "all" only watches entities carrying every selected label.
data_description.problem_states: Turns on when a watched entity's state is one of these. Monitored-entity sensors (device class "problem") are always included.
